caption: The drawing features four square swatches of patterned fabric or paper, arranged in a 2x2 grid on a plain, light beige background. The upper left swatch has a tan base with a repetitive pattern of small blue-gray squares and occasional clusters of red circles and blue-gray leaves. The upper right swatch has a deep red background with a consistent design of small, white floral or botanical motifs evenly distributed. The bottom left swatch is black and decorated with red flowers and grayish leaves, with the floral design distributed evenly across the swatch. The bottom right swatch has a tan background adorned with pink, red, and white floral patterns as well as scattered small flower shapes in red, distributed throughout the swatch. All four squares are similarly sized and spaced evenly apart, each displaying a different style of repeating pattern.
title: Quilt Patches
